semi weakly supervised object kinematic.quote: Due to the large variations in both topological structure and geometric details of 3D objects, this remains a challenging task and the lack of large scale labeled data also constrain the performance of deep learning based approaches.

semi weakly supervised object kinematic.subject: Semi-Weakly Supervised Object Kinematic Motion Prediction
semi weakly supervised object kinematic.claim: The network predictions yield a large scale of 3D objects with pseudo labeled mobility information that can be used for weakly-supervised learning with pre-existing segmentation.
semi weakly supervised object kinematic.quote: The network predictions yield a large scale of 3D objects with pseudo labeled mobility information and can further be used for weakly-supervised learning with pre-existing segmentation.

partmanip learning cross category genera.subject: PartManip
partmanip learning cross category genera.claim: PartManip is the first large-scale, part-based cross-category object manipulation benchmark composed of 11 object categories, 494 objects, and 1432 tasks in 6 task classes.
partmanip learning cross category genera.quote: In this work, we build the first large-scale, part-based cross-category object manipulation benchmark, PartManip, which is composed of 11 object categories, 494 objects, and 1432 tasks in 6 task classes.

partmanip learning cross category genera.subject: PartManip
partmanip learning cross category genera.claim: The benchmark uses sparse-view point cloud as input without oracle information like part segmentation.
partmanip learning cross category genera.quote: Compared to previous work, our benchmark is also more diverse and realistic, i.e., having more objects and using sparse-view point cloud as input without oracle information like part segmentation.

partmanip learning cross category genera.subject: Part-based canonicalization and part-aware rewards
partmanip learning cross category genera.claim: The authors train a state-based expert using proposed part-based canonicalization and part-aware rewards.
partmanip learning cross category genera.quote: To tackle the difficulties of vision-based policy learning, we first train a statebased expert with our proposed part-based canonicalization and part-aware rewards, and then distill the knowledge to a vision-based student.

partmanip learning cross category genera.subject: Vision-based student
partmanip learning cross category genera.claim: Knowledge from the state-based expert is distilled to a vision-based student.
partmanip learning cross category genera.quote: To tackle the difficulties of vision-based policy learning, we first train a statebased expert with our proposed part-based canonicalization and part-aware rewards, and then distill the knowledge to a vision-based student.

partmanip learning cross category genera.subject: Expressive backbone
partmanip learning cross category genera.claim: An expressive backbone is essential to overcome the large diversity of different objects.
partmanip learning cross category genera.quote: We also find an expressive backbone is essential to overcome the large diversity of different objects.

partmanip learning cross category genera.subject: Domain adversarial learning
partmanip learning cross category genera.claim: Domain adversarial learning is introduced for domain-invariant feature extraction to achieve cross-category generalization.
partmanip learning cross category genera.quote: For cross-category generalization, we introduce domain adversarial learning for domain-invariant feature extraction.

partmanip learning cross category genera.subject: PartManip policy
partmanip learning cross category genera.claim: The learned policy outperforms other methods by a large margin, especially on unseen object categories.
partmanip learning cross category genera.quote: Extensive experiments in simulation show that our learned policy can outperform other methods by a large margin, especially on unseen object categories.

carto category and joint agnostic recons.subject: CARTO
carto category and joint agnostic recons.claim: CARTO is a novel approach for reconstructing multiple articulated objects from a single stereo RGB observation using implicit object-centric representations.
carto category and joint agnostic recons.quote: We present CARTO, a novel approach for reconstructing multiple articulated objects from a single stereo RGB observation. We use implicit object-centric representations and learn a single geometry and articulation decoder for multiple object categories.

carto category and joint agnostic recons.subject: CARTO
carto category and joint agnostic recons.claim: The decoder achieves a comparable reconstruction accuracy to methods that train bespoke decoders separately for each category, despite being trained on multiple categories.
carto category and joint agnostic recons.quote: Despite training on multiple categories, our decoder achieves a comparable reconstruction accuracy to methods that train bespoke decoders separately for each category.

carto category and joint agnostic recons.subject: CARTO
carto category and joint agnostic recons.claim: CARTO infers the 3D shape, 6D pose, size, joint type, and the joint state of multiple unknown objects in a single forward pass.
carto category and joint agnostic recons.quote: Combined with our stereo image encoder we infer the 3D shape, 6D pose, size, joint type, and the joint state of multiple unknown objects in a single forward pass.

carto category and joint agnostic recons.subject: CARTO
carto category and joint agnostic recons.claim: CARTO achieves a 20.4% absolute improvement in mAP 3D IOU50 for novel instances when compared to a two-stage pipeline.
carto category and joint agnostic recons.quote: Our method achieves a 20.4% absolute improvement in mAP 3D IOU50 for novel instances when compared to a two-stage pipeline.

carto category and joint agnostic recons.subject: CARTO
carto category and joint agnostic recons.claim: CARTO can run on a NVIDIA TITAN XP GPU at 1 HZ for eight or less objects present.
carto category and joint agnostic recons.quote: Inference time is fast and can run on a NVIDIA TITAN XP GPU at 1 HZ for eight or less objects present.

carto category and joint agnostic recons.subject: CARTO
carto category and joint agnostic recons.claim: CARTO transfers to real-world object instances despite being only trained on simulated data.
carto category and joint agnostic recons.quote: While only trained on simulated data, CARTO transfers to real-world object instances.

opdmulti openable part detection for mul.subject: OPDFormer
opdmulti openable part detection for mul.claim: OPDFormer is a part-aware transformer architecture proposed to address the scenario of detecting openable parts in scenes with multiple objects.
opdmulti openable part detection for mul.quote: We then address this more challenging scenario with OPDFormer: a part-aware transformer architecture.

opdmulti openable part detection for mul.subject: OPDFormer
opdmulti openable part detection for mul.claim: The OPDFormer architecture significantly outperforms prior work in the investigated multiple-object scenarios.
opdmulti openable part detection for mul.quote: Our experiments show that the OPDFormer architecture significantly outperforms prior work.

opdmulti openable part detection for mul.subject: OPDFormer
opdmulti openable part detection for mul.claim: The more realistic multiple-object scenarios remain challenging for all methods, indicating opportunities for future work.
opdmulti openable part detection for mul.quote: The more realistic multiple-object scenarios we investigated remain challenging for all methods, indicating opportunities for future work.

saor single view articulated object reco.subject: SAOR
saor single view articulated object reco.claim: SAOR is a novel approach for estimating the 3D shape, texture, and viewpoint of an articulated object from a single image captured in the wild.
saor single view articulated object reco.quote: We introduce SAOR, a novel approach for estimating the 3D shape, texture, and viewpoint of an articulated object from a single image captured in the wild.

saor single view articulated object reco.subject: SAOR
saor single view articulated object reco.claim: SAOR learns to articulate shapes from single-view image collections with a skeleton-free part-based model without requiring any 3D object shape priors.
saor single view articulated object reco.quote: SAOR learns to articulate shapes from single-view image collections with a skeleton-free part-based model without requiring any 3D object shape priors.

saor single view articulated object reco.subject: cross-instance consistency loss
saor single view articulated object reco.claim: A cross-instance consistency loss is proposed to prevent ill-posed solutions by exploiting disentangled object shape deformation and articulation.
saor single view articulated object reco.quote: To prevent ill-posed solutions, we propose a cross-instance consistency loss that exploits disentangled object shape deformation and articulation.

saor single view articulated object reco.subject: silhouette-based sampling mechanism
saor single view articulated object reco.claim: A new silhouette-based sampling mechanism is used to enhance viewpoint diversity during training.
saor single view articulated object reco.quote: This is helped by a new silhouette-based sampling mechanism to enhance viewpoint diversity during training.

saor single view articulated object reco.subject: SAOR
saor single view articulated object reco.claim: SAOR only requires estimated object silhouettes and relative depth maps from off-the-shelf pre-trained networks during training.
saor single view articulated object reco.quote: Our method only requires estimated object silhouettes and relative depth maps from off-the-shelf pre-trained networks during training.

saor single view articulated object reco.subject: SAOR
saor single view articulated object reco.claim: SAOR obtains improved qualitative and quantitative results on challenging quadruped animals compared to relevant existing work.
saor single view articulated object reco.quote: We obtain improved qualitative and quantitative results on challenging quadruped animals compared to relevant existing work.

active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.subject: Active Coarse-to-Fine Segmentation of Moveable Parts
active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.claim: The paper introduces the first active learning model for high-accuracy instance segmentation of moveable parts from RGB images of real indoor scenes.
active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.quote: We introduce the first active learning (AL) model for high-accuracy instance segmentation of moveable parts from RGB images of real indoor scenes.

active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.subject: Transformer with masked-attention mechanism
active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.claim: The model employs a transformer that utilizes a masked-attention mechanism to supervise the active segmentation.
active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.quote: To this end, we employ a transformer that utilizes a masked-attention mechanism to supervise the active segmentation.

active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.subject: Coarse-to-fine AL approach
active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.claim: The approach uses an object-aware masked attention first and then a pose-aware one, leveraging the hierarchical nature of the problem and a correlation between moveable parts and object poses and interaction directions.
active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.quote: To enhance the network tailored to moveable parts, we introduce a coarse-to-fine AL approach which first uses an object-aware masked attention and then a pose-aware one, leveraging the hierarchical nature of the problem and a correlation between moveable parts and object poses and interaction directions.

active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.subject: Active Coarse-to-Fine Segmentation of Moveable Parts
active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.claim: Applying the model to 2,000 real images yields fully validated moveable part segmentations with semantic labels by manually annotating only 11.45% of the images.
active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.quote: When applying our AL model to 2,000 real images, we obtain fully validated moveable part segmentations with semantic labels, by only needing to manually annotate 11.45% of the images.

active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.subject: Active Coarse-to-Fine Segmentation of Moveable Parts
active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.claim: The method achieves a 60% time saving over the manual effort required by the best non-AL model to attain the same segmentation accuracy.
active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.quote: This translates to significant (60%) time saving over manual effort required by the best non-AL model to attain the same segmentation accuracy.

active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.subject: Dataset of 2,550 real images
active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.claim: The authors contribute a dataset of 2,550 real images with annotated moveable parts, demonstrating its superior quality and diversity over the best alternatives.
active coarse to fine segmentation of mo.quote: At last, we contribute a dataset of 2,550 real images with annotated moveable parts, demonstrating its superior quality and diversity over the best alternatives.

self supervised category level articulat.subject: Self-Supervised Category-Level Articulated Object Pose Estimation with Part-Level SE(3) Equivariance
self supervised category level articulat.claim: The paper presents a novel self-supervised strategy that solves category-level articulated object pose estimation without any human labels.
self supervised category level articulat.quote: To reduce the heavy annotations needed for supervised learning methods, we present a novel self-supervised strategy that solves this problem without any human labels.

self supervised category level articulat.subject: Part-level SE(3) equivariant shape analysis
self supervised category level articulat.claim: The key idea is to factorize canonical shapes and articulated object poses from input articulated shapes through part-level equivariant shape analysis.
self supervised category level articulat.quote: Our key idea is to factorize canonical shapes and articulated object poses from input articulated shapes through part-level equivariant shape analysis.

self supervised category level articulat.subject: Part-level SE(3) equivariant network
self supervised category level articulat.claim: The authors introduce the concept of part-level SE(3) equivariance and devise a network to learn features of such property.
self supervised category level articulat.quote: Specifically, we first introduce the concept of part-level SE(3) equivariance and devise a network to learn features of such property.

self supervised category level articulat.subject: Fine-grained pose-shape disentanglement strategy
self supervised category level articulat.claim: A carefully designed fine-grained pose-shape disentanglement strategy is used to automatically induce canonical spaces that support pose estimation.
self supervised category level articulat.quote: Then, through a carefully designed fine-grained pose-shape disentanglement strategy, we expect that canonical spaces to support pose estimation could be induced automatically.

self supervised category level articulat.subject: Self-Supervised Category-Level Articulated Object Pose Estimation with Part-Level SE(3) Equivariance
self supervised category level articulat.claim: Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the method on both complete and partial point clouds from synthetic and real articulated object datasets.
self supervised category level articulat.quote: Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on both complete and partial point clouds from synthetic and real articulated object datasets.

deep learning based motion style transfe.subject: DL-based motion style transfer approaches
deep learning based motion style transfe.claim: The paper provides a comprehensive comparative analysis of existing state-of-the-art deep learning-based motion style transfer approaches.
deep learning based motion style transfe.quote: This paper provides a comprehensive comparative analysis of existing state-of-the-art DL-based motion style transfer approaches.

deep learning based motion style transfe.subject: motion style transfer
deep learning based motion style transfe.claim: Motion style transfer employs existing captured motion data to generate realistic samples automatically and updates the motion data accordingly.
deep learning based motion style transfe.quote: motion style transfer approach employs existing captured motion data to generate realistic samples automatically and updates the motion data accordingly.

deep learning based motion style transfe.subject: deep learning (DL) algorithms
deep learning based motion style transfe.claim: Deep learning algorithms reshape motion style transfer approaches because they can predict subsequent motion styles.
deep learning based motion style transfe.quote: The popularity of deep learning (DL) algorithms reshapes motion style transfer approaches, as such algorithms can predict subsequent motion styles.

deep learning based motion style transfe.subject: training dataset
deep learning based motion style transfe.claim: The selection of the training dataset plays a key role in the performance when employing deep learning-based methods for motion style transfer.
deep learning based motion style transfe.quote: When employing DL-based methods for motion style transfer, the selection of the training dataset plays a key role in the performance.

deep learning based motion style transfe.subject: motion style transfer approaches
deep learning based motion style transfe.claim: The paper highlights the contemporary challenges faced by motion style transfer approaches.
deep learning based motion style transfe.quote: As an outcome of the extensive overview of the domain, this paper highlights the contemporary challenges faced by motion style transfer approaches.

ditto in the house building articulation.subject: Ditto in the House
ditto in the house building articulation.claim: The approach discovers possible articulated objects through affordance prediction, interacts with these objects to produce articulated motions, and infers articulation properties from visual observations.
ditto in the house building articulation.quote: Our approach, named Ditto in the House, discovers possible articulated objects through affordance prediction, interacts with these objects to produce articulated motions, and infers the articulation properties from the visual observations before and after each interaction.

ditto in the house building articulation.subject: Ditto in the House
ditto in the house building articulation.claim: The approach tightly couples affordance prediction and articulation inference to improve both tasks.
ditto in the house building articulation.quote: It tightly couples affordance prediction and articulation inference to improve both tasks.

ditto in the house building articulation.subject: Ditto in the House
ditto in the house building articulation.claim: The effectiveness of the approach is demonstrated in both simulation and real-world scenes.
ditto in the house building articulation.quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in both simulation and real-world scenes.

ditto in the house building articulation.subject: Prior work on articulation reasoning
ditto in the house building articulation.claim: Prior work on articulation reasoning primarily focuses on siloed objects of limited categories.
ditto in the house building articulation.quote: Prior work on articulation reasoning primarily focuses on siloed objects of limited categories.

generating human motion from textual des.subject: T2M-GPT
generating human motion from textual des.claim: The paper investigates a conditional generative framework based on VQ-VAE and GPT for human motion generation from textual descriptions.
generating human motion from textual des.quote: In this work, we investigate a simple and must-known conditional generative framework based on Vector Quantised-Variational AutoEncoder (VQ-VAE) and Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) for human motion generation from textural descriptions.

generating human motion from textual des.subject: CNN-based VQ-VAE
generating human motion from textual des.claim: A simple CNN-based VQ-VAE with EMA and Code Reset allows for obtaining high-quality discrete representations.
generating human motion from textual des.quote: We show that a simple CNN-based VQ-VAE with commonly used training recipes (EMA and Code Reset) allows us to obtain high-quality discrete representations.

generating human motion from textual des.subject: T2M-GPT
generating human motion from textual des.claim: A simple corruption strategy is incorporated during GPT training to alleviate training-testing discrepancy.
generating human motion from textual des.quote: For GPT, we incorporate a simple corruption strategy during the training to alleviate training-testing discrepancy.

generating human motion from textual des.subject: T2M-GPT
generating human motion from textual des.claim: T2M-GPT achieves better performance than competitive approaches, including recent diffusion-based approaches.
generating human motion from textual des.quote: Despite its simplicity, our T2M-GPT shows better performance than competitive approaches, including recent diffusion-based approaches.

generating human motion from textual des.subject: T2M-GPT
generating human motion from textual des.claim: On HumanML3D, T2M-GPT achieves an FID of 0.116, largely outperforming MotionDiffuse's FID of 0.630.
generating human motion from textual des.quote: For example, on HumanML3D, which is currently the largest dataset, we achieve comparable performance on the consistency between text and generated motion (R-Precision), but with FID 0.116 largely outperforming MotionDiffuse of 0.630.

generating human motion from textual des.subject: T2M-GPT
generating human motion from textual des.claim: The dataset size is observed to be a limitation of the approach.
generating human motion from textual des.quote: Additionally, we conduct analyses on HumanML3D and observe that the dataset size is a limitation of our approach.

locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.subject: LAMA
locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.claim: LAMA is a unified framework designed to synthesize natural and plausible long-term human movements in complex indoor environments by encompassing locomotion, scene interaction, and object manipulation.
locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.quote: We present LAMA, Locomotion-Action-MAnipulation, to synthesize natural and plausible long- term human movements in complex indoor environments. The key motivation of LAMA is to build a unified framework to encompass a series of everyday motions including locomotion, scene interaction, and object manipulation.

locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.subject: LAMA
locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.claim: LAMA formulates the synthesis problem as a test-time optimization using human motion capture data only, rather than requiring motion data paired with scanned 3D scenes.
locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.quote: Unlike existing methods that require motion data "paired" with scanned 3D scenes for supervision, we formulate the problem as a test-time optimization by using human motion capture data only for synthesis.

locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.subject: LAMA
locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.claim: LAMA leverages a reinforcement learning framework coupled with a motion matching algorithm for optimization.
locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.quote: LAMA leverages a reinforcement learning framework coupled with a motion matching algorithm for optimization, and further exploits a motion editing framework via manifold learning to cover possible variations in interaction and manipulation.

locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.subject: LAMA
locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.claim: LAMA exploits a motion editing framework via manifold learning to cover possible variations in interaction and manipulation.
locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.quote: LAMA leverages a reinforcement learning framework coupled with a motion matching algorithm for optimization, and further exploits a motion editing framework via manifold learning to cover possible variations in interaction and manipulation.

locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.subject: LAMA
locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.claim: LAMA outperforms previous approaches in synthesizing realistic motions in various challenging scenarios.
locomotion action manipulation synthesiz.quote: Throughout extensive experiments, we demonstrate that LAMA outperforms previous approaches in synthesizing realistic motions in various challenging scenarios.

hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.subject: Hi-LASSIE
hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.claim: Hi-LASSIE performs 3D articulated reconstruction from only 20–30 online images in the wild without any user-defined shape or skeleton templates.
hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.quote: We propose Hi-LASSIE, which performs 3D articulated reconstruction from only 20–30 online images in the wild without any user-defined shape or skeleton templates.

hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.subject: Hi-LASSIE
hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.claim: Hi-LASSIE automatically estimates a class-specific skeleton from the selected reference image instead of relying on a manually annotated 3D skeleton.
hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.quote: First, instead of relying on a manually annotated 3D skeleton, we automatically estimate a class-specific skeleton from the selected reference image.

hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.subject: Hi-LASSIE
hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.claim: Hi-LASSIE improves shape reconstructions with novel instance-specific optimization strategies that allow reconstructions to faithfully fit on each instance while preserving class-specific priors.
hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.quote: Second, we improve the shape reconstructions with novel instance-specific optimization strategies that allow reconstructions to faithful fit on each instance while preserving the class-specific priors learned across all images.

hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.subject: Hi-LASSIE
hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.claim: Experiments on in-the-wild image ensembles show that Hi-LASSIE obtains higher fidelity state-of-the-art 3D reconstructions despite requiring minimum user input.
hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.quote: Experiments on in-the-wild image ensembles show that Hi-LASSIE obtains higher fidelity state-of-the-art 3D reconstructions despite requiring minimum user input.

hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.subject: prior methods
hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.claim: Most prior methods rely on large-scale image datasets, dense temporal correspondence, or human annotations like camera pose, 2D keypoints, and shape templates.
hi lassie high fidelity articulated shap.quote: Most prior methods rely on large-scale image datasets, dense temporal correspondence, or human annotations like camera pose, 2D keypoints, and shape templates.

full body articulated human object inter.subject: CHAIRS
full body articulated human object inter.claim: CHAIRS is an extensive motion-captured f-AHOI dataset comprising 17.3 hours of diverse interactions involving 46 participants and 81 articulated as well as rigid sittable objects.
full body articulated human object inter.quote: We introduce CHAIRS, an extensive motion-captured f-AHOI dataset comprising 17.3 hours of diverse interactions involving 46 participants and 81 articulated as well as rigid sittable objects.

full body articulated human object inter.subject: CHAIRS
full body articulated human object inter.claim: The CHAIRS dataset provides 3D meshes of both humans and articulated objects throughout the interactive sequences, offering realistic and physically plausible full-body interactions.
full body articulated human object inter.quote: The CHAIRS provides 3D meshes of both humans and articulated objects throughout the interactive sequences, offering realistic and physically plausible full-body interactions.

full body articulated human object inter.subject: proposed model
full body articulated human object inter.claim: The proposed model employs human pose estimation to address articulated object pose and shape estimation within whole-body interactions.
full body articulated human object inter.quote: Leveraging the geometric relationships inherent in HOI, we propose a pioneering model that employs human pose estimation to address articulated object pose and shape estimation within whole-body interactions.

full body articulated human object inter.subject: proposed model
full body articulated human object inter.claim: Given an image and an estimated human pose, the model reconstructs the object’s pose and shape, refining the reconstruction based on a learned interaction prior.
full body articulated human object inter.quote: Given an image and an estimated human pose, our model reconstructs the object’s pose and shape, refining the reconstruction based on a learned interaction prior.

full body articulated human object inter.subject: proposed model
full body articulated human object inter.claim: Across two evaluation scenarios, the model significantly outperforms baseline methods.
full body articulated human object inter.quote: Across two evaluation scenarios, our model significantly outperforms baseline methods.

full body articulated human object inter.subject: previous models
full body articulated human object inter.claim: Previous models often assume that humans interact with rigid objects using only a few body parts, constraining their applicability.
full body articulated human object inter.quote: However, previous models often assume that humans interact with rigid objects using only a few body parts, constraining their applicability.

imos intent driven full body motion synt.subject: IMoS
imos intent driven full body motion synt.claim: IMoS is the first framework to synthesize the full-body motion of virtual human characters performing specified actions with 3D objects placed within their reach.
imos intent driven full body motion synt.quote: we present the first framework to synthesize the full‐body motion of virtual human characters performing specified actions with 3D objects placed within their reach.

imos intent driven full body motion synt.subject: IMoS
imos intent driven full body motion synt.claim: The system takes textual instructions specifying the objects and the associated ‘intentions’ of the virtual characters as input and outputs diverse sequences of full-body motions.
imos intent driven full body motion synt.quote: Our system takes textual instructions specifying the objects and the associated ‘intentions’ of the virtual characters as input and outputs diverse sequences of full‐body motions.

imos intent driven full body motion synt.subject: intent‐driven full‐body motion generator
imos intent driven full body motion synt.claim: The intent-driven full-body motion generator uses a pair of decoupled conditional variational auto-regressors to learn the motion of the body parts in an autoregressive manner.
imos intent driven full body motion synt.quote: We accomplish our objective by designing an intent‐driven full‐body motion generator, which uses a pair of decoupled conditional variational auto‐regressors to learn the motion of the body parts in an autoregressive manner.

imos intent driven full body motion synt.subject: IMoS
imos intent driven full body motion synt.claim: The system optimizes the 6-DoF pose of the objects such that they plausibly fit within the hands of the synthesized characters.
imos intent driven full body motion synt.quote: We also optimize the 6‐DoF pose of the objects such that they plausibly fit within the hands of the synthesized characters.

imos intent driven full body motion synt.subject: IMoS
imos intent driven full body motion synt.claim: The proposed method establishes a new and stronger state-of-the-art for the task of intent-driven motion synthesis compared to existing methods.
imos intent driven full body motion synt.quote: We compare our proposed method with the existing methods of motion synthesis and establish a new and stronger state‐of‐the‐art for the task of intent‐driven motion synthesis.

imos intent driven full body motion synt.subject: existing works
imos intent driven full body motion synt.claim: Existing full-body action synthesis methods generally do not consider object interactions.
imos intent driven full body motion synt.quote: This contrasts existing works, where full‐body action synthesis methods generally do not consider object interactions, and human‐object interaction methods focus mainly on synthesizing hand or finger movements for grasping objects.

imos intent driven full body motion synt.subject: existing works
imos intent driven full body motion synt.claim: Existing human-object interaction methods focus mainly on synthesizing hand or finger movements for grasping objects.
imos intent driven full body motion synt.quote: This contrasts existing works, where full‐body action synthesis methods generally do not consider object interactions, and human‐object interaction methods focus mainly on synthesizing hand or finger movements for grasping objects.

one shot implicit animatable avatars wit.subject: ELICIT

one shot implicit animatable avatars wit.quote: we propose ELICIT, a novel method for learning human-specific neural radiance fields from a single image.

one shot implicit animatable avatars wit.subject: ELICIT

one shot implicit animatable avatars wit.subject: ELICIT
one shot implicit animatable avatars wit.claim: ELICIT implements the visual clothing semantic prior with the CLIP-based pre-trained models.

one shot implicit animatable avatars wit.subject: ELICIT
one shot implicit animatable avatars wit.claim: ELICIT can use text descriptions to generate text-conditioned unseen regions.

one shot implicit animatable avatars wit.subject: ELICIT
one shot implicit animatable avatars wit.claim: ELICIT proposes a segmentation-based sampling strategy that locally refines different parts of the avatar.

one shot implicit animatable avatars wit.subject: ELICIT

fast snarf a fast deformer for articulat.subject: Fast-SNARF
fast snarf a fast deformer for articulat.claim: Fast-SNARF is a new articulation module for neural fields that finds accurate correspondences between canonical space and posed space via iterative root finding.
fast snarf a fast deformer for articulat.quote: We propose a new articulation module for neural fields, Fast-SNARF, which finds accurate correspondences between canonical space and posed space via iterative root finding.

fast snarf a fast deformer for articulat.subject: Fast-SNARF
fast snarf a fast deformer for articulat.claim: Fast-SNARF yields a speed-up of 150x over SNARF through algorithmic and implementation improvements.

captra category level pose tracking for.subject: CAPTRA

captra category level pose tracking for.quote: For the first time, we propose a unified framework that can handle 9DoF pose tracking for novel rigid object instances as well as per-part pose tracking for articulated objects from known categories.

captra category level pose tracking for.quote: Our pipeline is composed of three modules: 1) a pose canonicalization module that normalizes the pose of the input depth point cloud; 2) RotationNet, a module that directly regresses small interframe delta rotations; and 3) CoordinateNet, a module that predicts the normalized coordinates and segmentation, enabling analytical computation of the 3D size and translation.

captra category level pose tracking for.subject: RotationNet
captra category level pose tracking for.claim: RotationNet is a module that directly regresses small interframe delta rotations.
captra category level pose tracking for.quote: 2) RotationNet, a module that directly regresses small interframe delta rotations;

captra category level pose tracking for.subject: CAPTRA

captra category level pose tracking for.quote: Our extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves new state-of-the-art performance on category-level rigid object pose (NOCSREAL275 [29]) and articulated object pose benchmarks (SAPIEN [34], BMVC [18]) at the fastest FPS ∼ 12.

captra category level pose tracking for.subject: CAPTRA

captra category level pose tracking for.quote: Leveraging the small pose regime in the pose-canonicalized point clouds, our method integrates the best of both worlds by combining dense coordinate prediction and direct rotation regression, thus yielding an end-to-end differentiable pipeline optimized for 9DoF pose accuracy (without using non-differentiable RANSAC).

articulated object interaction in unknow.subject: two-stage architecture
